decisions.reason: After the firm already removed the more aggressive express variants, the remaining fifteen-day program is easier to defend as the stable core service concept, so sunk process investment and the ability to blame any issues on execution keep withdrawal unlikely.

This certified fire-resistant exterior door is highly visible, tightly tied to the firm's safety-focused core range, and backed by prior development and public launch commitment, making management very reluctant to reverse course.

The online ordering and digital services platform sits at the center of the firm's announced move toward deeper advisory and service support, so accumulated IT investment and strategic justification strongly favor continuing it.

Because the fire and smoke protection door extends the established compliance-and-safety offering and can still be framed as needing market build-up rather than redesign, management is likely to persist with it.
